description: PANIC is a panoramic near-infrared camera designed for Calar Alto, optimised for the 2.2 m telescope and also usable at the 3.5 m telescope. Its filter set comprises Z, Y, J, H and Ks broad bands and H2 and Br-gamma narrow bands.
facility_description: Calar Alto Observatory is located in the Sierra de Filabres in Almería, Spain, and is jointly operated by IAA-CSIC and the Andalusian Government.
notes: The IAA instrument site is retained for historical purposes and describes the original mosaic camera. Parameters are quoted at 100 K in a converging beam; do not substitute the upgraded camera response. CAHA website permission terms cannot automatically license IAA-hosted files; no filter-specific grant found on the IAA overview, instrument or publications pages. Research accessed 2026-10-26. General CAHA observing acknowledgement is conditional on observational data and a proposal identifier; no observing proposal or SVO use is invented for these filter curves. Rights checked against CAHA legal notice (https://www.caha.es/es/?option=com_content&view=article&id=14725) and data management plan (https://www.caha.es/joomlaCMS/images/docs/DMPlan-CAHA.pdf); neither establishes an unambiguous grant for these third-party filter files.
